projects.title: Mesocast.net
projects.description:
I started Mesocast.net hoping to provide weather data to meteorologists, scientists, and weather enthusiasts as quickly as possible, efficiently, and with the highest quality. This is the first-ever web application to GL render Nexrad Level 2 (Hi-Res weather radar) data in the market. It also delivers data from the radar site to clients in under 10 seconds and consistently in 3-5 seconds. Ahead of the most commonly used weather apps by 40 seconds to 5 minutes. A feat that resulted from a great passion for wanting to save and improve people's lives

The application is rich in all aspects of web development including OAuth, streaming and reading binary data over websockets, Protobuf, React, Typescript, Prisma ORM, mathematical computations for coordinate transformations and color mapping of data, including satellite data, model data, and various other GeoJSON data. The application utilizes Webgl for rendering graphics with raw vertices and matrix calculations.

This application is free to use for basic resolution data and is available to the public, the mission of Mesocast is to provide life-saving data as soon as possible and to grow and produce models for predicting significant weather events.
